Data:Nxh.n.tapestry.investigated.connie..desc:
'I had worried, more than a little, about that angle too. Perhaps in the end the Bureau really is just Calyptra's executioner... I'm getting out. It'll cause a fuss: I'll need to lie low for a while. Thank you, Librarian. I couldn't have made this decision without you. I hope we meet again some day.'

[Connie will resign from the Bureau, and will no longer appear as a Visitor, but may still be recruited to the Lighthouse Institute...]

'This is what brought Nocturnal Branch down… there's a lot here about Ortucchio that I didn't know. We dealt with it before. We'll deal with it again… and I'll be there to make sure it's done right. Thank you, Librarian. Wish me luck.'

Data:Nxh.n.tapestry.investigated.t.exerc.desc:
'The Haustorium really is insidious, isn't it? ...this clinches it for me. I can do more good outside the Bureau than inside. This is going to cause a fuss: I'll need to lie low for a while. Thank you, Librarian. I couldn't have made this decision without you. I hope we meet again some day.'

[Connie will resign from the Bureau, and will no longer appear as a Visitor, but may still be recruited to the Lighthouse Institute...]

Data:Nxh.n.wood.assisted.stanislav.lisel.desc: Liselotte is gone, and the Blomberende-kind with her. We will not see either of them again.
Liselotte is gone. The Blomberende-kind remain in the Brancrug beehive, both grateful and quiescent.

Data:Nxh.n.wood.investigated.douglas.r.i.desc: 'Thanks, Librarian. Once we've taken Liselotte into custody, this'll sort out her brood. I almost feel sorry for her. I shouldn't, though. That's how they get you.'

Data:Nxh.n.wood.investigated.stanislav.r.desc: 'That was what I needed. I think, now, that Kitling Ripe will find the Blomberende-kind suitably tempting; it will find them and dispose of them. Regrettable. But I am determined it's safer this way. We should not forget the Cross, but neither should we welcome it.'

Data:Nxh.n.wood.investigated.stanislav.t.desc: 'Librarian… let me introduce you to a friend of mine. You will recognise her name. She has an idea. Brancrug Isle is a place outside the world. If you were prepared to host her breeding females here - 'landgravines-in-exile', she calls them - then they will be safe until and unless the world turns. You have her word, and mine, that they will not molest you, nor any visitors.'

Data:Nxi.n.debt.arun.arun.and.kaunas.jso.label: Arun and Kaunas?
Data:Nxi.n.debt.arun.arun.and.kaunas.jso.preface: Did Arun manage to create 'peace through confusion'?
Data:Nxi.n.debt.arun.arun.and.kaunas.jso.desc: 'It was a knot of mysteries, wasn't it? And I couldn't find the end.. Ask someone else.'

Data:Nxi.n.debt.azita.azita.and.kaunas.j.label: Azita and Kaunas?
Data:Nxi.n.debt.azita.azita.and.kaunas.j.preface: Did Azita manage to 'knock heads together'?
Data:Nxi.n.debt.azita.azita.and.kaunas.j.desc: 'We never did get to the bottom of it, did we? Perhaps the Reckoners will tire themselves out eventually.'

Data:Nxi.n.debt.connie.connie.and.kaunas.label: Connie and Kaunas?
Data:Nxi.n.debt.connie.connie.and.kaunas.preface: Did Connie find out what was happening in Kaunas?
Data:Nxi.n.debt.connie.connie.and.kaunas.desc: 'I didn't have time to follow up the lead. The Bureau has many calls on our time. I hope we won't regret letting it go.'

Data:Nxi.n.heist.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.label: Ask Dagmar
Data:Nxi.n.heist.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.preface: 'Can't promise anything, but old Daymare knows who's who, can put the word around, ask what's which, apply the old lemon? Least I can do.' [Dagmar will freely share anything she discovers.]
Data:Nxi.n.heist.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.desc: 'Well I've had a damned good think and a dashed good snout around and all I can say is that's all I can say. One of the eternal ineffabilities, what? Meantersay I can't tell you who did it. If anyone did it. Sorry, Libsy.'

Data:Nxi.n.heist.forget.the.matter.json.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxi.n.heist.forget.the.matter.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.con.label: Confront and Expose Dagmar
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.con.desc: 'Can't blame you, Libsy, took my chance and muffed it, didn't I? Sick to death of eating out of tins, but couldn't bear to see the things go to the wrong homes. Who was it shopped me? That little drab Coquille? That oik Hokobald? No, don't tell me, I shall waste time getting very cross with them. Well, here we are. One must take one's lumps.'

Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.label: Promise Silence; Mention Nowhere
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.preface: 'Absolutely, Libsy. Appreciate the discretion.' [Dagmar will support a Secrecy Agenda and Fear: Nowhere.]
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.desc: 'Took my chance and muffed it, didn't I? Sick to death of eating out of tins, but couldn't bear to see the things go to the wrong homes.  Well, here we are. Always thought the things under the Mansus should stay under the Mansus, count on me to help keep 'em there.'

Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.label: Promise Silence; Mention the Chandler
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.preface: 'Absolutely, Libsy. Appreciate the discretion. Happy to sign up to your thing.'  [Dagmar will support a Secrecy Agenda and Fear: Chandler.]
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.desc: 'Took my chance and muffed it, didn't I? Sick to death of eating out of tins, but couldn't bear to see the things go to the wrong homes.  Well, here we are. Never really understood what the Chander's sposed to be, but if it ends up being anything, count on me to... count on me.'

Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.label: Promise Silence; Mention Ys
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.preface: 'Absolutely, Libsy. Appreciate the discretion. Happy to sign up to your thing.' [Dagmar will support a Secrecy Agenda and Fear: Ys.]
Data:Nxi.n.heist.investigated.dagmar.pro.desc: 'Took my chance and muffed it, didn't I? Sick to death of eating out of tins, but couldn't bear to see the things go to the wrong homes.  Well, here we are. Count on me to help keep Ys at bay if it needs keeping.'

Data:Nxi.n.invisible.salvaged.arun.congr.label: Congratulate Arun
Data:Nxi.n.invisible.salvaged.arun.congr.preface: The dissemination of the Reckoners' Wangle has already distracted the Madrugad from her work with the Calyptra. Now, it will be much easier to distract her further.
Data:Nxi.n.invisible.salvaged.arun.congr.desc: 'I will take the Orient Express to Cologne, where I will meet with certain Reckoner friends. We will go on together to Venice, where we will… propagate these roses. Calyptra is not invulnerable, Librarian. Everything seems invulnerable until it is destroyed.'

Data:Nxi.n.invisible.salvaged.olympe.con.label: Congratulate Olympe
Data:Nxi.n.invisible.salvaged.olympe.con.preface: The dissemination of the Reckoners' Wangle has already distracted the Madrugad from her work with the Calyptra. Now, it will be much easier to distract her further.
Data:Nxi.n.invisible.salvaged.olympe.con.desc: 'I'm heading back East - I know a retired Reckoner in Tiflis. I think he'll come out of retirement for this. We'll head down to Venice and take cuttings from the roses. It's going to complicate the years trade. But it's going to complicate the Calyptra's work a lot more. Wish me luck, Librarian.'

Data:Nxi.n.mystique.revealed.recall.yvet.label: Recall Yvette
Data:Nxi.n.mystique.revealed.recall.yvet.desc: Elie's plans will be stillborn - or must alter in the womb to something even chancier. In any case, they will no longer trouble the Librarian of Hush House.

Data:Nxi.n.rising.interpreted.connie.aba.label: Abandon an Oracle?
Data:Nxi.n.rising.interpreted.connie.aba.desc: 'I don't know where she's gone, and if there's one thing this job has taught me, it's that sometimes curiosity is best unfed. Thank you, Librarian. I'm relieved that I never had to make this decision. And I'm relieved that the Oracle of the Rising While has its limits.'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.escape.json.label: Escape
Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.escape.json.preface: Did Coquille follow through on her  desire to open the Casket? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.escape.json.desc: 'Yes indeed; I was able to free the Messenger. I'm told he's grateful that Hush House decided not to assist that von Nagelsburg woman in keeping him imprisoned. Here's a sign of his gratitude. Perhaps if you have an altar to the Chancel, you should place it there...'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.no.escape.jso.label: No Escape?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.no.escape.jso.preface: What happened with the Messenger's Casket? I could ask Coquille.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.no.escape.jso.desc: 'I did my best, but the von Nagelburg women is a nuisance. Especially with your assistance… not that I'm blaming you, darling, I know how the House must be. The Messenger can sometimes be seen in the world now, in mirrors and paintings, but the seals on the Casket still partly hold...'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.thwarted.by.d.label: Thwarted by Dagmar?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.thwarted.by.d.preface: Did Coquille follow through on her desire to open the Casket? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.coquille.thwarted.by.d.desc: 'I did my damnedest, but the von Nagelburg women is a nuisance. Especially with your assistance… not that I'm blaming you, darling, I know the House is the House. The prisoner can be seen in the world now, in mirrors and paintings, but the seals on the Casket still partly hold...'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.confinement.jso.label: Confinement
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.confinement.jso.preface: Did Dagmar succeed in her design to seal the Casket? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.confinement.jso.desc: 'Yes all good, glad you didn't help anyone else let it go, but also glad you brought it up, meaning to speak to you. Box feller's image made it out into the world, outer ring of significance as it were. Can you put this somewhere safe? Meantersay if you have for instance a special sort of sarcophagus in your cellar somewhere...'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.no.safety.json.label: No Safety?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.no.safety.json.preface: What happened with the Messenger's Casket? I could ask Dagmar.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.no.safety.json.desc: 'Did my best but Coquille keeps trying to crack the thing open and Wakefield is doing what ever he's doing. Didn't come to you for advice, did they? Better not tell me. Anyway, the seals on the Casket are cracking…'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.thwarted.by.coq.label: Thwarted by Coquille?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.thwarted.by.coq.preface: Did Dagmar succeed in her design to seal the Casket? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.thwarted.by.coq.desc: 'Bloody Coquille. Did my best but she's a proper little vixen. You didn't help her, did you? No don't tell me, better off not knowing. Anyway, the seals on the Casket are cracking…'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.thwarted.by.zac.label: Thwarted by Zachary?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.thwarted.by.zac.preface: Did Dagmar succeed in her design to seal the Casket? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.dagmar.thwarted.by.zac.desc: 'Bloody Wakefield. Did my best but the poor fellow kept getting in the way. Don't really know if he even knew what he was doing, really. Proper little champion of the liberties. Anyway, the seals on the Casket are cracking…'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.escape.json.label: Escape
Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.escape.json.preface: Did Zachary succeed in his hinted plan to open the Casket? I could ask him.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.escape.json.desc: 'I chose freedom. None opposed me. I freed the Messenger. Here: take this, to dwell on your threemost altar. There may then be fewer regrets. I hope.'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.no.surcease.js.label: No Surcease?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.no.surcease.js.preface: What happened with the Messenger's Casket? I could ask Zachary.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.no.surcease.js.desc: 'You helped us; you also helped Dagmar von Nagelsburg. There is the balance. The seals on the Casket are cracked; the Messenger may not yet escape, though his image is now seen in the world. There is another balance.'

Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.thwarted.by.da.label: Thwarted by Dagmar?
Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.thwarted.by.da.preface: Did Zachary succeed in his hinted plan to open the Casket? I could ask him.
Data:Nxs.n.casket.zachary.thwarted.by.da.desc: 'You helped me; you also helped Dagmar von Nagelsburg. There is the balance. The seals on the Casket are cracked; the Messenger cannot yet escape, though his image is now seen in the world. There is another balance.'

Data:Nxs.n.claw.agdistis.talk.to.agdisti.label: Talk to Agdistis
Data:Nxs.n.claw.agdistis.talk.to.agdisti.desc: 'I did. And I brought something back. I do not trust the Cross. But the Cross spoke to me; they answered questions I had about what does not cease. I have agreed that if the Librarian permits it, I will make an offering at the shrine of St Tentreto which - the Cross tells me - lies in the caves below Hush House...'

Data:Nxs.n.claw.ehsan.catch.up.with.ehsa.label: Catch up with Ehsan
Data:Nxs.n.claw.ehsan.catch.up.with.ehsa.desc: 'I helped him suppress the drive to go West; and so he stayed. I believe we brought him peace, now, and from what I am learning of the Cross, I think we might also have kept him safe. This is an end to it: thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxs.n.claw.ehsan.talk.to.ehsan.json.label: Talk to Ehsan
Data:Nxs.n.claw.ehsan.talk.to.ehsan.json.desc: 'I could not help him suppress the drive to go West; and so he went. Perhaps it was the right thing to do. He seems happier now. He's asked me a favour - to make an offering at a certain shrine - a Carapace shrine that he tells me lies in the caves below Hush House. No, I can't imagine how he knows it's there, or even how he's heard of Hush House. Perhaps the wind told him. Here's the offering. Will you pour it out for me?'

Data:Nxs.n.claw.forget.the.matter.json.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.claw.forget.the.matter.json.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.claw.forget.the.matter.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.
